presentation.label: Tempo LED marks the pattern's 1
presentation.summary: The tempo LED flashes green on the pattern's 1 while the sequencer plays; every other beat stays red.
presentation.overview: A visual downbeat for players who can't use the click track, for example when the cue outputs feed external effects. While the sequencer plays, the tempo LED flashes green on the first beat of each pass of the pattern and red on every other beat, as stock does. It reads the sequencer's own step, so it follows the pattern length, scale and pattern changes. Stopped, it is stock. Nothing to set: install it and press PLAY.
highlights: Green on the pattern's 1, stock red on every other beat.
Reads the sequencer's master step: follows pattern length, scale, pattern changes, tempo and external MIDI clock.
No menu, no knob, no project data: remove the module and the LED is stock again.
usage: Press [PLAY]: the first flash is green, then red until the pattern comes round again.
Set the pattern's length (FUNC + PAGE, PATTERN SCALE) to 12 or 20 steps: the green still lands on the pattern's first step.
Press [STOP]: the LED behaves as stock, and the next [PLAY] starts green again.

access.location: The tempo LED, while the sequencer plays
steps: Press [PLAY]: the first flash is green, then red until the pattern comes round again.
Set the pattern's length (FUNC + PAGE, PATTERN SCALE) to 12 or 20 steps: the green still lands on the pattern's first step.
Press [STOP]: the LED behaves as stock, and the next [PLAY] starts green again.

limitations: OS 1.40C. The tempo LED only flashes on whole beats: when the pattern's 1 falls mid-beat (say 14 steps at 1x), the green comes on the first flash after it.
Green is LED id 39, the pair of stock's red 38; seen green on an MKI (reported, card build), MKII not tested.
Not yet tested: pausing and continuing, a pattern change while playing, external MIDI clock, the USB package.

storage.label: ColdFire code and state
storage.conditions: One linked unit: 58 bytes of code, 2 of padding and one 4-byte last-step word; the USB package is 196 bytes. One six-byte detour. No DSP memory.

processing.label: ColdFire, once per beat
processing.conditions: At most 11 instructions before stock's set_led, once per beat (24 clock ticks), in stock's clock-message loop. Nothing per sample or per frame.

impact.conditions: Once per beat in stock's clock-message loop.

cpu.rationale: At most 11 ColdFire instructions once per beat.

tests.summary: Reported by the tester on an MKI (2 November 2026), as a native card build in their private octabam remix home-base 5 booted through REMIX SWITCH: red while stopped; green on the pattern's first beat while playing, in several play modes and with a 17-step master length. ot_emu on stock 1.40C: every beat flash on master step 0 asks for id 39 and every other for stock's 38 at 12, 16 and 20 steps (verify.py). The USB package has not run on a unit.
